metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.8 · 1987 · Predator
metas.description: A team of commandos on a mission in a Central American jungle find themselves hunted by an extraterrestrial warrior.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.3 · 1990 · Predator 2
metas.description: Los Angeles police hunt an alien creature in 1997.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.4 · 2010 · Predators
metas.description: A group of elite warriors parachute into an unfamiliar jungle and are hunted by members of a merciless alien race.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.3 · 2018 · The Predator
metas.description: When a young boy accidentally triggers the universe's most lethal hunters' return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and a disgruntled scientist can prevent the end of the human race.

metas.description: Naru, a skilled warrior of the Comanche Nation, fights to protect her tribe against one of the first highly-evolved Predators to land on Earth.

metas.description: A young Predator outcast from his clan finds an unlikely ally on his journey in search of the ultimate adversary.
